Name: Abiezer, Son of Hammoleketh
Summary: Son of Hammoleketh, named in Manasseh's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:18: Son of Hammoleketh, named in Manasseh's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Abiezer stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
